title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Registration): 8. What is the procedure for issue of duplicate registration certificate ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Registration): 8. What is the procedure for issue of duplicate registration certificate ?. 8. What is the procedure for issue of duplicate registration certificate ? Any registered owner can apply for a duplicate registration certificate in cases where the original one is either, lost, damaged or mutilated. Following documents needed: Application in form 26 (in duplicate and with the endorsement from the financier, if hypothecated). Original copy of the F.I.R. Copies of valid insurance policy/pollution under control certificate/tax token. NOC from traffic police & Enforcement wing of Transport Department. Affidavit in support of the application.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Registration): 10. How can the hypothecation be endorsed or deleted ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Registration): 10. How can the hypothecation be endorsed or deleted ?. 10. How can the hypothecation be endorsed or deleted ? If a vehicle is purchased on loan from a financier the same should be endorsed in the registration certificate. Similarly when the loan is repaid in full the fact of termination of hypothecation is also required to be endorsed. The following documents are required for the same: Registration certificate in original. Form no.34 duly filled (for endorsement of Hypothecation). Form no. 35 duly filled (for deletion of Hypothecation) in duplicate. A certificate from financier for having retained full dues from the financier (for deletion case only) Copies of valid insurance/pollution under control certificate/tax token.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 1. What is a Permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 1. What is a Permit ?. 1. What is a Permit ? Permit is an instrument/permission issued by the State Transport Authority or any Regional Transport Authority to use a motor vehicle as a transport vehicle.

text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 2. What are Stage Carriage, Contract Carriage, Private Service Vehicle & Public Service Vehicle Permit ?. 2. What are Stage Carriage, Contract Carriage, Private Service Vehicle & Public Service Vehicle Permit ? Stage Carriage are those vehicles constructed to carry more than 6 passengers excluding the driver for hire individual passenger either for the whole journey or for various stages of the journey. Contract Carriage means a motor vehicle which carries a passenger for hire & is engaged under a contract on a fixed or an agreed rate or sum; on a time basis or for a journey from one point to another. Public Service Vehicle means any motor vehicle used for carriage of passengers for hire and it includes motor cab, maxi cab, contract carriage and stage carriage.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 3. Who can apply for permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 3. Who can apply for permit ?. 3. Who can apply for permit ? An Indian citizen / any transport operator/ Co-operative Societies willing to enter into the transport business can apply for a permit of any category of vehicle of his / her / its choice.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 4. What is the difference (function wise} of STA & RTA ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 4. What is the difference (function wise} of STA & RTA ?. 4. What is the difference (function wise} of STA & RTA ? STA means the State Transport Authority . It is authorized to issue Stage Carriage Permit for Four and more than 4(Four) Regions (Districts), All Bengal Luxury Taxi Permit, Inter State Permit, etc. RTA means the Regional Transport Authority for a particular Revenue District. It is authorized to issue Stage Carriage Permit for 3(Three) Districts, Contract Carriage Permit, Taxi-Permit, Goods Permit, National Permit etc.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 5. What are the functions executed by the Regional Transport Authority regarding control of permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 5. What are the functions executed by the Regional Transport Authority regarding control of permit ?. 5. What are the functions executed by the Regional Transport Authority regarding control of permit ? Issuance of new offer-letters & subsequently permits, renewal of permits, transfer of ownership of the commercial vehicles & transfer of permit there of, replacement of commercial vehicles, necessary endorsements on the permits ( HPA, HPTER, Change of address/route alignments, replaced·vehicles etc), issuance duplicate permit ( in case of lost ,torn, defaced permit).

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 6. What are the full form of O.L., HPA, HPTER, S.L, C.C. P.S. V., H.S.R.P., C.o.F. ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Permit): 6. What are the full form of O.L., HPA, HPTER, S.L, C.C. P.S. V., H.S.R.P., C.o.F. ?. 6. What are the full form of O.L., HPA, HPTER, S.L, C.C. P.S. V., H.S.R.P., C.o.F. ? O.L. – Offer-Letter, HPA – Addition of Higher Purchase Agreement, HPTER – Deletion of Higher Purchase Agreement, S.L. – Sanction Letter, C.C. – Contract Carriage, P.S.V. – Private/Public Service Vehicle, H.S.R.P . – High Security Registration Plate, C.O.F. – Certificate of Fitness.

text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpter): 7. What are the requisite Forms & Fees for different kind of Permits issued by the Regional Transport Authority ?. 7. text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpter): 7. What are the requisite Forms & Fees for different kind of Permits issued by the Regional Transport Authority ?. title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpter): 8. What are the requisite Forms and Fees of Renewal of Permit, Transfer of Permit etc.?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpter): 8. What are the requisite Forms and Fees of Renewal of Permit, Transfer of Permit etc.?. 8. Govt Fees as Applicable Transfer of Permit Application in plain sheet of papers along with form no-29,30&31(death) requisite documents Govt Fees as Applicable Replacement of vehicles Application in plain sheet of papers along with requisite documents Govt Fees as Applicable HPA & HPTER Form no-35,34 Govt Fees as Applicable Any endorsement on permit Application with requisite documents Govt Fees as Applicable Endorsement of route alignment Application with requisite documents Govt Fees as Applicable

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 9. What are the procedures of obtaining Stage/ 6Spl.Staqe carriage permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 9. What are the procedures of obtaining Stage/ 6Spl.Staqe carriage permit ?. 9. What are the procedures of obtaining Stage/ 6Spl.Staqe carriage permit ? Application in Form no-I coupled with photo copy of address proof(EPIC preferably), PAN Card, P.Tax, 1-T return, Bank pass book, Coloured Photograph of the applicant is to be submitted before the RTA for a specific route as per choice of the applicant. Upon hearing before the RTA Board & on availability of vacancy in the route ( for which permit is applied for) Offer-Letter is issued to the applicant. On completion of registration of the vehicle as per technical specification, Permit is issued on realization of Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 10. How Contract Carriage Permit can be obtained ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 10. How Contract Carriage Permit can be obtained ?. 10. How Contract Carriage Permit can be obtained ? Application in Form no-XIII coupled with photo copy of address proof, PAN Card, P.Tax, I-T return, Bank pass book, Colour Photograph of the applicant is to be submitted before the RTA for the specific regions as per choice of the applicant. Upon hearing before the RTA Board, Offer-Letter is issued to the applicant. On completion of Registration of the vehicle as per technical specification, Permit is issued on realization of Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 11. What process are to be carried out for transfer of ownership of a commercial vehicle ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 11. What process are to be carried out for transfer of ownership of a commercial vehicle ?. 11. What process are to be carried out for transfer of ownership of a commercial vehicle ? This procedure is called Transfer of Permit or Transfer of Ownership of the vehicle. In that case a joint application of the buyer & the seller together with Form no- 29 & 30 ( Form no-31 in case of Death), address proof & PAN Card of both the buyer & the seller, affidavits sworn by the buyer, the seller & jointly by both of them, Form no-35, N.O.C. of the Financier(if the vehicle is hypothecated),all valid documents (tax token, Insurance certificate, PUC,CoF,RC) are to be submitted before the RTA. After observance of some procedure i,e verification of sale of the vehicle, hearing regarding transfer of permit, the ownership of the said

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 11. What process are to be carried out for transfer of ownership of a commercial vehicle ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 11. What process are to be carried out for transfer of ownership of a commercial vehicle ?. Insurance certificate, PUC,CoF,RC) are to be submitted before the RTA. After observance of some procedure i,e verification of sale of the vehicle, hearing regarding transfer of permit, the ownership of the said commercial vehicles is transferred from the seller to the buyer.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 12. What is the procedure of replacing an existing commercial vehicle ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 12. What is the procedure of replacing an existing commercial vehicle ?. 12. What is the procedure of replacing an existing commercial vehicle ? The holder of a permit may, with the permission of the authority by which the permit was granted, replace any vehicle covered by the permit by any other vehicle of the same nature. In case of KMC, Salt Lake & Lake town Police station areas plying of commercial vehicle is restricted upto 15 years from the date of initial registration. Application in a plain sheet of paper along with valid tax token, insurance certificate, PUC, COF, of the existing vehicles and NOC of the fin?ncier, if hypothecated, are to be submitted along with application fees of Rs.1000/-before the authority.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 13. What is the validity period of O.L. S.L. & replacement order ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 13. What is the validity period of O.L. S.L. & replacement order ?. 13. What is the validity period of O.L. S.L. & replacement order ? The Offer-Letter, Sanction Letter & Replacement Order are issued for 30(thirty) days. The validity period can be extended, as per approyal of the authority, upto 180 days on submission of Form-21/Temporary registration document & the Govt. revenues.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 14. What is the procedure of renewal of permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 14. What is the procedure of renewal of permit ?. 14. What is the procedure of renewal of permit ? Application in prescribed Form ( Form no-I for Stage Carriage/ Spl. Stage Carriage & Form no-II for Contract Carriage) along with valid CoF, Insurance certificate, Tax Token, NOC of the Financier (if the vehicle is hypothecated) are to be submitted with application Fee of Rs.500/-. Renewal of Permit for the next 5 years considering the age of the vehicle (15 years restricted for commercial vehicle) is granted on realization of Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 15. What is the procedure of obtaining new National Permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 15. What is the procedure of obtaining new National Permit ?. 15. What is the procedure of obtaining new National Permit ? Application in form no-46 coupled with photo copy of address proof, PAN Card, 1-T return, Bank Pass Book, Coloured Photo of the applicant is to be submitted before the RTA for a specific route as per choice of the applicant. Upon hearing before the RTA Board Offer-Letter is issued to the applicant. On completion of registration of the vehicles as per technical specification permit is issued on realization of Govt. fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 16. What is Private Service Vehicle Permit & How is it obtained ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 16. What is Private Service Vehicle Permit & How is it obtained ?. 16. What is Private Service Vehicle Permit & How is it obtained ? Any institution can procure this kind of Permit for carrying staffs of its concern without any profit making purposes. Application in prescribed Form no-XIII along with the valid RC,Tax token, Insurance certificate, PUC, CoF, certificate of the concern, address proof of the concern are to be submitted & application Fees is to be deposited.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 17. How can addition I deletion of HPA be done on the Permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 17. How can addition I deletion of HPA be done on the Permit ?. 17. How can addition I deletion of HPA be done on the Permit ? Application on plain sheet of paper along with vehicle particulars for HPA or HPTER is to be submitted supported by all valid documents related to the vehicle. A Fees of Rs. 300/- is realized.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 18. If a part of permit is torn, defaced or the Permit is lost, what is to be done ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 18. If a part of permit is torn, defaced or the Permit is lost, what is to be done ?. 18. If a part of permit is torn, defaced or the Permit is lost, what is to be done ? Upon the prayer of the permit holder the authority verifies if any police case is pending against the Permit Vehicle. On the basis of police verification report and on realization of a fees of Rs.1000/- per part duplicate permit is issued.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 19. If one gets an Offer-Letter of a Stage Carriage/ Sp/. Stage Carriage Permit what is the next course of action ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 19. If one gets an Offer-Letter of a Stage Carriage/ Sp/. Stage Carriage Permit what is the next course of action ?. 19. If one gets an Offer-Letter of a Stage Carriage/ Sp/. Stage Carriage Permit what is the next course of action ? The offeree is to purchase a vehicle of appropriate Class and approved make as per CMVR 1989. The vehicle is to be Registered in favour of the offeree. Then the offeree can apply for the permanent permit by producing the vehicle particulars, valid tax-token, insurance certificate of the vehicle.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 20. What is the procedure of submitting application under Gatidhara Scheme ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 20. What is the procedure of submitting application under Gatidhara Scheme ?. 20. What is the procedure of submitting application under Gatidhara Scheme ? Application is to be submitted in prescribed form, (the Gatidhara facilitator- MV Dealer, would help & facilitate applicant to file application), The application should be supported by the following documents:- Proof of enrollment in employment bank, photo copy of proof of age c) residential proof(preferably EPIC) proof of Bank Account Income certificate of family issued by MLA/MP, ZP/PSMembers, Municipal Councillor etc Quotation of Vehicle, self declaration and one duly filled application for offer-Letter.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 21. What is the 8.S Norms of vehicles applicable in respect of RTA Kolkata ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 21. What is the 8.S Norms of vehicles applicable in respect of RTA Kolkata ?. 21. What is the 8.S Norms of vehicles applicable in respect of RTA Kolkata ? For new registration BS-IV compliance vehicles only.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 22. What are the basic parameters for eligibility under Gatidhara scheme ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 22. What are the basic parameters for eligibility under Gatidhara scheme ?. 22. What are the basic parameters for eligibility under Gatidhara scheme ? He/She is an unemployed youth of this State enrolled with Employment Bank, He/She has completed 20th years but not 45th year of age as on 1st day of April of the year. The upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC,ST & 3 years for OBC candidates Family income does not exceed Rs.25000/- per month The State Govt. shall provide subsidy or grant of 30% of project cost subject to maximum of Rs.100000/- While besides the Subsidy/ Grant of the State Govt, rest is supposed to be loan from the Financier, it would be better if He/She contributes a portion project cost as initial down payment.

text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 23. What is the approved fare rate of ordinary Bus Service in respect ofKolkata City ?. 23. title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 24. What is the approved fare rate of ordinary Mini-Bus, Special/Non-Ac JNNURM Service/Limited Services Bus in respect of Kolkata City ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Hpa & Hpter): 24. What is the approved fare rate of ordinary Mini-Bus, Special/Non-Ac JNNURM Service/Limited Services Bus in respect of Kolkata City ?. 24. title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 1. What is Certificate of fitness (CoF) ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 1. What is Certificate of fitness (CoF) ?. 1. What is Certificate of fitness (CoF) ? The transport vehicles i.e Commercial vehicles require a valid Certificate of Fitness along with the registration certificate. Under the provisions of The M.V. Act, the registration of vehicle is treated as valid only if the vehicle have valid certificate of fitness.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 2. How long the Fitness Certificate remains valid?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 2. How long the Fitness Certificate remains valid?. 2. How long the Fitness Certificate remains valid? In case of Transport vehicles the fitness certificates is valid for 2 years in case of new vehicle and subsequently it is renewed for one year.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 3. Where should I approach for fitness of vehicles?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Certificate Of Fitness): 3. Where should I approach for fitness of vehicles?. 3. Where should I approach for fitness of vehicles? The motor vehicle office where it is registered or is going to be registered is to be approached. The vehicle will be inspected by Motor Vehicle Inspector (Technical) at the time of first registration and subsequent fitness for its road worthiness. REMEMBER : To drive vehicle without fitness certificate is an offence and the vehicle is treated as not validly registered.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): 4. What are the documents required for renewal of certificate of fitness?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): 4. What are the documents required for renewal of certificate of fitness?. 4. What are the documents required for renewal of certificate of fitness?

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): A. Documents required for renewal of COF are:
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): A. Documents required for renewal of COF are:. A. Documents required for renewal of COF are: Registration certificate. Form CFA. Old C.O.F.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): B. Self-attested copies of valid Tax Token/Insurance Certificate/Pollution under control certificate.
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): B. Self-attested copies of valid Tax Token/Insurance Certificate/Pollution under control certificate.. B. Self-attested copies of valid Tax Token/Insurance Certificate/Pollution under control certificate. Prescribed Fees Any other document as may be required by Registering Authority.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): 5. Can my vehicle fitness certificate be cancelled if my fitness certificate is valid but the vehicle is not safe & sound?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Remember): 5. Can my vehicle fitness certificate be cancelled if my fitness certificate is valid but the vehicle is not safe & sound?. 5. Can my vehicle fitness certificate be cancelled if my fitness certificate is valid but the vehicle is not safe & sound? Yes it can be. You have to maintain your vehicle fit through out the years in safe and sound condition. NOTE: For details, please contact the office of your local Registering Authority.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 1. What is a Driving License? Who can get it ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 1. What is a Driving License? Who can get it ?. 1. What is a Driving License? Who can get it ? A Driving License is a legal permission to drive a Motor Vehicle. Any person (Indian Citizen or OCI or Foreign National residing in India) having requisite age, Educational Qualification (wherever applicable), Proof of residence in an area under jurisdiction of a particular Licensing Authority and ability to drive a Motor Vehicle can be issued a Driving License.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 2. Who is the Licensing Authority ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 2. Who is the Licensing Authority ?. 2. Who is the Licensing Authority ? In Kolkata: Director, PVD, Kolkata or any officer authorized by him (up to the rank of MVls). In Districts: District Magistrate or any officer authorized by him (up to the rank of MVls). (RTO/ARTO/MVls). In Sub-Division: any officer authorized by the District Magistrate (up to the rank of MVls). (ARTO/MVls).

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. How one can get Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. How one can get Driving License ?. 3. How one can get Driving License ? On due application (to the Licensing Authority in the place of residence) in prescribed form with documents and fees, a preliminary test is taken, 60% is the pass mark to get the Learner’s Driving License which remains valid up to a maximum period of 180 days. The Candidate can appear after at least 30(thirty) days (so that the candidate can learn driving of a particular type of Motor Vehicle duly) for a driving test on due application in prescribed form with fees . A Driving License shall be issued if the candidate passes the Driving Test.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 4. With the Learner’s Driving License, may one drive a Motor vehicle? How a regular Driving License can be obtained ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 4. With the Learner’s Driving License, may one drive a Motor vehicle? How a regular Driving License can be obtained ?. 4. With the Learner’s Driving License, may one drive a Motor vehicle? How a regular Driving License can be obtained ? With a Learner’s Driving License one can drive a Motor Vehicle as Learner accompanied by an Instructor holding an effective Driving License with “L” board displayed prominently in the front and rear of the vehicle. After a lapse of a minimum period of thirty days, a Learner’s Driving License holder can apply (within 180 days) for a regular Driving License.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. What are the requirements to get a Learner’s Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. What are the requirements to get a Learner’s Driving License ?. 5. What are the requirements to get a Learner’s Driving License ? Application in Form 1 and 2 of C.M.V.Rules 1989 Documents required as evidence as to correctness of address and age – Electoral Roll. Life Insurance Policy. Passport. Pay Slip issued by any office of the Central Government or a State Government or a Local body (PRIs/ULBs). School Certificate. Birth Certificate. Certificate granted by a registered medical practitioner not below the rank of a Civil Surgeon as to the age of the applicant. Any other document or documents as prescribed by the State Government under clause (k) of section 28. Proof of legal presence in India in addition to proof of residence in case of foreigners. Three passport sized recent photographs. Government fees. Age: Motor Cycle without

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. What are the requirements to get a Learner’s Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. What are the requirements to get a Learner’s Driving License ?. clause (k) of section 28. Proof of legal presence in India in addition to proof of residence in case of foreigners. Three passport sized recent photographs. Government fees. Age: Motor Cycle without Gear: 16 years & above. Light Motor Vehicle (Non-Transport) : 18 years & above. Transport Category: 20 years & above. Vehicles Carrying Dangerous Goods : As in (iii) above & in addition at least 3(three) days specialised training on the specific subject. Consent of parent or guardian, in case of application made by minor for learner’s license to drive motor cycle without gear is required. Educational Qualification: For MCWOG, MCWG & LMV (NT): Optional. For Transport Vehicle: Minimum class eighth standard pass.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 6. What happens if an applicant fails in the test for Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 6. What happens if an applicant fails in the test for Driving License ?. 6. What happens if an applicant fails in the test for Driving License ? Can again apply for a Driving License test after seven days.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 7. What are the essentials for getting a Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 7. What are the essentials for getting a Driving License ?. 7. What are the essentials for getting a Driving License ? Applicationin Form 4 of C.M.V.Rules 1989. An effective learner’s license to drive the vehicle of the type to which the application relates and issued not less than 30(thirty) days ago. Govt. fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 8. How one can renew Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 8. How one can renew Driving License ?. 8. How one can renew Driving License ? Application in Form 9 and 1A of C.M.V.Rules 1989. Original Driving Licence. To apply not before 30 days prior to expiry or not after five years of expiry. Govt. fees and D/L Smart card fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ?. 9. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ? Application in Form- LLD. A general diary to any Police Station regarding loss of Driving License. An affidavit regarding loss of D/L. Govt. fee and D/L Smart card fee.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 10. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 10. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ?. 10. How one can get duplicate Driving License, if Lost/Destroyed/Mutilated ? Application in Form 2 and 8 of C.M.V. Rules 1989. An effective learner’s license to drive the vehicle of the type to which the application relates and issued not less than 30 (thirty) days ago. Driving Certificate in Form 5 from a Motor Training School, in case for addition of a Transport Vehicle category. Minimum educational qualification in case of Transport Vehicle shall be class eighth standard pass. Govt. Fees Rs.70/- plus Rs.290/- and D/L Smart card fee Rs.140/-.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 11. How one can change address in Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 11. How one can change address in Driving License ?. 11. How one can change address in Driving License ? Application in plain paper to the licensing authority in whose jurisdiction the applicant resides. Proof of address- like as learner’s driving license. Original Driving License and particulars / N.O.C. from the Licensing Authority by whom the D/L was issued in case of coming from other region. Govt. Fees Rs.240/- and D/L Smart card fee Rs.140/-.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 12. Is it mandatory to undergo Motor Driving Training School to get a Driving License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 12. Is it mandatory to undergo Motor Driving Training School to get a Driving License ?. 12. Is it mandatory to undergo Motor Driving Training School to get a Driving License ? For getting a Driving License of any Non-Transport vehicle, no training course in MTS is mandatory. For getting a Driving License of any Transport vehicle, such training in MTS and certificate in Form-5 is mandatory.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 13. How one can get a certified copy of Driving License/NOC ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 13. How one can get a certified copy of Driving License/NOC ?. 13. How one can get a certified copy of Driving License/NOC ? Application in plain paper clearly mention the driving licence number to the licensing authority by whom the D/L was issued. Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 14. How can one get a Conductor’s License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 14. How can one get a Conductor’s License ?. 14. How can one get a Conductor’s License ? Application in Form L.Con.A. and Medical Certificate in Form M.C.Con. to the Licensing Authority having jurisdiction. Age- not less than 18 years. Proof of address- like as in question 5 above. Minimum educational qualification- Pass in class IV standard. Two clear copies of recent passport sized photograph. Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 15. How Conductor’s License can be renewed ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 15. How Conductor’s License can be renewed ?. 15. How Conductor’s License can be renewed ? Application Forms requires- Form L.Con.A. and and Medical Certificate in Form M.C.Con. Proof of address- like as learner’s driving licence. Two clear copies of recent passport size photograph. Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 16. How one can get duplicate Conductor’s License, if lost ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 16. How one can get duplicate Conductor’s License, if lost ?. 16. How one can get duplicate Conductor’s License, if lost ? Application Form requires- Form CLO. A general diary to any Police Station regarding loss of C/L. An affidavit regarding loss of C/L. Two copies of recent passport size photograph. Govt. Fees.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 17. How can One get an International Driving Permit ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 17. How can One get an International Driving Permit ?. 17. How can One get an International Driving Permit ? Application Form in Form IDP-1. Medical Certificate in Form 1A. Age not below 18 years. Current Indian driving license valid for at least next one year. Current address proof. Valid International Passport. Valid proof of visa, where applicable. Three copies of recent Passport sized photographs. Passing a fresh driving test if driving license issued is less than ten years old. Fees for two-wheeler Rs.2500/- and four-wheeler Rs. 4000/-. Generally IDP remains valid for one year only and not renewable ( For further requirement of IDP, fresh application may be preferred).

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 18. How can one apply for Motor Training School License ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 18. How can one apply for Motor Training School License ?. 18. How can one apply for Motor Training School License ? For grant of new license, application in Form 12 of C.M.V.R. Rules 1989 (Form-13 for renewal of License) to the Licensing Authority having jurisdiction in the area in which the M.T.S. is situated. Government fees thereof. Must have suitable infrastructures of at least one Dual Control Vehicle, Qualified Instructor, Adequate Training Charts/Materials, Class Room Facilities etc. (As detailed in rules 24, 27, 31 of C.M.V. Rules 1989).

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 1. What is Road Tax or Motor Vehicles Tax (MV Tax) ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 1. What is Road Tax or Motor Vehicles Tax (MV Tax) ?. 1. What is Road Tax or Motor Vehicles Tax (MV Tax) ? Road tax or Motor Vehicles Tax (MV Tax) is the tax that needs to be paid on motor vehicle. This tax is applicable on all the private and commercial vehicles.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 2. Who has to pay MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 2. Who has to pay MV Tax ?. 2. Who has to pay MV Tax ? Every owner of a registered motor vehicle or every person who owns or keeps in his possession or control any motor vehicle has to pay MV Tax. Also every dealer or manufacturer, who keeps in his possession or control any motor vehicle on the basis of a trade Certificate, has to pay MV Tax.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. Where to pay the MV Taxes ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. Where to pay the MV Taxes ?. 3. Where to pay the MV Taxes ? The MV tax is to be deposited at the motor vehicle offices (RTO/ARTO Offices) where the vehicle stands registered with. The road tax is to be paid to the Public Vehicles Departments in Kolkata and other Regional Transport Offices in the Districts and ARTO offices at the Sub-Divisions having motor vehicle offices. The road tax is to be paid to the Taxing Officer of the MV Office having jurisdiction over the place of Residence/ Business of the Vehicle owner. For Kolkata, at the appropriate unit office of PV D, Kolkata (Beltala or Kasba or Salt Lake) and for Districts/ Sub-Divisions, at the RTO/ARTO Offices. The Bank Draft would be in favour of the Taxing Officer of the relevant MV Office

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. Where to pay the MV Taxes ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 3. Where to pay the MV Taxes ?. D, Kolkata (Beltala or Kasba or Salt Lake) and for Districts/ Sub-Divisions, at the RTO/ARTO Offices. The Bank Draft would be in favour of the Taxing Officer of the relevant MV Office payable at the relevant City (Kolkata/Medinipur/Siligri etc)

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 4. What are the modes of payment of MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 4. What are the modes of payment of MV Tax ?. 4. What are the modes of payment of MV Tax ? MV Tax is to be deposited either in cash or Demand Draft/Pay Order. (On Line E-payment mode is going to be introduced shortly in all MV Offices in a time bound manner.)

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. Who are the Taxing Officers ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 5. Who are the Taxing Officers ?. 5. Who are the Taxing Officers ? The Taxing Officers are the officers up to the rank of ARTO in the Districts and Sub-Divisions, Assistant Director (Tax) for PVD, Kolkata and ARTOs for PVD, Kasha & PVD, Salt Lake.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 6. Is there any grace period for payment of MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 6. Is there any grace period for payment of MV Tax ?. 6. Is there any grace period for payment of MV Tax ? There is a grace pe riod of 15 d ays for paym ent of tax without penalty after the date of expiry.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 7. What are the documents required for payment of MV Taxes ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 7. What are the documents required for payment of MV Taxes ?. 7. What are the documents required for payment of MV Taxes ? The required documents are: A signed and duly filled declaration form Copies oflnsurance Certificate and PUCC. Original Tax Token (Right hand side part)

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 8. What happens if one fails to pay taxes in time ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 8. What happens if one fails to pay taxes in time ?. 8. What happens if one fails to pay taxes in time ? One cannot legally use the vehicle on road w ithout payment of MV Road T ax or after expiry of Tax paym ent validity per iod . Such v ehicle may also be impounded by the enforcement wing if found plying on road. Penalties on tax also start accruing. The vehicle may also be aucti oned by th e government for realization of government dues. The permit also becom es automatically invalid.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?. 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ? There is a grace period of 15 days for payment of t ax w ithout p enalty aft er expiry. Penalty is charged thereafter @ 25% for delay in payment during the period of 16th day to 45th day after expiry. Penalty is charged th ereafter@ 50% for delay in paym ent during the period of 46th day to 75th day after expiry, and Penalty is charged there after @ 100% for delay in payment after the 75th day after expiry. For vehicles against which One-time Tax is payable the rate of penalties are : grac e period of 15 days for payment of tax without penalty after expiry; Penalty is charged thereafter

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?. For vehicles against which One-time Tax is payable the rate of penalties are : grac e period of 15 days for payment of tax without penalty after expiry; Penalty is charged thereafter @ 1/20th part for delay in payment during the period of 16th day to 45th day after expiry, then @ 1/10th part for delay in payment during th e period of 46th day to 75th day after expiry; then @ 1/5th part for delay in payment after the 75th day after expiry; then @ 2/5th part for delay in p ayment during the period of 1st year and the 2nd year after expiry; then @ 3/5th part for delay in payment during the period of 2nd year and the 3rd year after expiry; then @ 4/5th

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 9. What are the rates of penalty for delay in payment of MV Tax ?. of 1st year and the 2nd year after expiry; then @ 3/5th part for delay in payment during the period of 2nd year and the 3rd year after expiry; then @ 4/5th part for delay in payment during the period of 3rd year and the 4th year aft er expiry, and and finally @ 100% for delay in payment after the 4th year after expiry. Further, if the tax is not paid against any vehicle even after 30 days of detention of the vehicle for nonpayment of taxes, then the liability goes up to double the amount of taxes due plus the penalty applicable as above.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 10. What type of MV Tax one is needed to deposit for a new private car ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 10. What type of MV Tax one is needed to deposit for a new private car ?. 10. What type of MV Tax one is needed to deposit for a new private car ? One has the option to deposit either One-time tax or Life-time tax for a new private car. One-time tax is valid for five years and Life-time tax is valid for entire life of the car.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 11. What type of MV Tax is to be deposited for a two wheeler ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 11. What type of MV Tax is to be deposited for a two wheeler ?. 11. What type of MV Tax is to be deposited for a two wheeler ? It is needed to deposit Life-time tax for a new two wheeler.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 12. Is it needed to pay MV Tax again for this State if one brings a vehicle from another State with NOC ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 12. Is it needed to pay MV Tax again for this State if one brings a vehicle from another State with NOC ?. 12. Is it needed to pay MV Tax again for this State if one brings a vehicle from another State with NOC ? Yes, if one brings a vehicle to West Bengal which is registered outside West Bengal with NOC, one has to pay MV Tax for West Bengal as applicable against the vehicle and such tax will be realized from the date of issuance of NOC. (In that case claim for refund of MV Tax already paid in the previous State, if any, is to be preferred to the Taxing Officer of that previous State which shall be disposed off in accordance with the provisions of prevailing MV Tax Act / Rules of the relevant State).

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 13. Is there any scope of refund of the deposited MV tax if the vehicle is taken out from West Bengal to another State with NOC ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 13. Is there any scope of refund of the deposited MV tax if the vehicle is taken out from West Bengal to another State with NOC ?. 13. Is there any scope of refund of the deposited MV tax if the vehicle is taken out from West Bengal to another State with NOC ? If one moves his/her vehicle from this State (WB) to another, he/she is eligible for refund of taxes only after re-assignment of the vehicle with that State’s registration number, for the remainder period. (A plain paper application seeking refund, Tax Token, attested photocopy of the new registration mark in the other State and one blank/cancelled cheque of his/her Bank Account is to be submitted.)

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 14. What is the procedure to get a duplicate Tax Token, if the original Token is lost or torn/defaced/mutilated ?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Driving License): 14. What is the procedure to get a duplicate Tax Token, if the original Token is lost or torn/defaced/mutilated ?. 14. What is the procedure to get a duplicate Tax Token, if the original Token is lost or torn/defaced/mutilated ? Following documents to be submitted for getting a duplicate Tax Token: N.O.C. from Lalbazar, Traffic Department, Kolkata. Missing Diary of Tax Token at Police Station in case of Loss of Tax Token. Affidavit (Notary public) Valid Insurance Policy. N.O.C. from Financier (for hypothecated vehicles) Torn or defaced Tax Token.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 1. Do I need to pay fines for not having the pollution certificate?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 1. Do I need to pay fines for not having the pollution certificate?. 1. Do I need to pay fines for not having the pollution certificate? Any vehicle, not carrying a valid PUC Certificate is liable to be prosecuted under Section 190(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 2. Where should I get my vehicle pollution level checked and PUCC issued?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 2. Where should I get my vehicle pollution level checked and PUCC issued?. 2. Where should I get my vehicle pollution level checked and PUCC issued? At the licensed Auto Emission Testing Centers (AETC). Such centers are available at many Fuelling Stations or Workshops and are spread all over the State. These centers issue Pollution Under Control Certificates (PUCC), if the vehicle is found meeting prescribed emission norms, which includes taking photo of the vehicle.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 3. What happens if my vehicle is found visibly polluting although I am carrying a valid PUC certificate?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 3. What happens if my vehicle is found visibly polluting although I am carrying a valid PUC certificate?. 3. What happens if my vehicle is found visibly polluting although I am carrying a valid PUC certificate? You will be directed as per provisions of the rule 116 of CMVR to get the vehicle repaired, retested and to produce a fresh PUC Certificate within seven days. The failure to comply with this direction would result in prosecution under section 190(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 4. What is the validity period for a PUCC?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 4. What is the validity period for a PUCC?. 4. What is the validity period for a PUCC? PUCC is valid for six months at a time.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 5. My vehicle is BS-III / BS-IV compliant. Do I need to obtain a PUC Certificate?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Pollution): 5. My vehicle is BS-III / BS-IV compliant. Do I need to obtain a PUC Certificate?. 5. My vehicle is BS-III / BS-IV compliant. Do I need to obtain a PUC Certificate? As per Central Motor Vehicle Rules, 1989, every motor vehicle (including those conforming to BS-III / BS-IV, as well as, vehicles plying on LPG) is required to carry a valid PUC Certificate.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 1. Do you understand seizure of documents of your vehicle?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 1. Do you understand seizure of documents of your vehicle?. 1. Do you understand seizure of documents of your vehicle? This is the process of recording a prima-facie offence by the enforcement agencies for violations of the Motor Vehicle Act and the rules made there under. Seizure List is a document prepared by the enforcement agency for this purpose.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 2. Under what circumstances case may be lodged against your vehicle?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 2. Under what circumstances case may be lodged against your vehicle?. 2. Under what circumstances case may be lodged against your vehicle? Enforcement wing deploys its teams for checking compliance of legal provisions by the vehicle owners / drivers in terms of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 and the Rules made there under. You may be stopped by one of these teams. You may be asked to produce the following documents: Driving License. Registration Certificate. Insurance certificate. Pollution under control certificate. Permits (for commercial vehicles only). Certificate of fitness (for commercial vehicles only). Road Tax Receipt. Any other related document. If you are not carrying the above mentioned documents or found violating any of the Rules / Regulations, a case may be registered against you and your documents and even the vehicle may also be seized depending upon the

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 2. Under what circumstances case may be lodged against your vehicle?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 2. Under what circumstances case may be lodged against your vehicle?. mentioned documents or found violating any of the Rules / Regulations, a case may be registered against you and your documents and even the vehicle may also be seized depending upon the violation of sections of the M V Act 1988, The Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, the West Bengal Motor Vehicle Rules 1989, The West Bengal Motor Vehicles Tax Act, 1979 and The West Bengal Additional Tax & One-time Tax on Motor Vehicles Act, 1989.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 3. Can your vehicle be seized by the enforcement wing?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 3. Can your vehicle be seized by the enforcement wing?. 3. Can your vehicle be seized by the enforcement wing? Yes. Seizure of vehicle means impounding of a vehicle by the enforcement agencies for offences committed under the Motor Vehicle Act and rules made there under and also for non-payment of taxes. The seized vehicle is released only after all the government dues and custodial fees, if any, are paid.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 4. What happens when a case is lodged against your vehicle?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 4. What happens when a case is lodged against your vehicle?. 4. What happens when a case is lodged against your vehicle? Seizure list will be issued to you containing some of the following details: The authority before which you are required to appear. Date by which to appear. Prima facie details of offences committed. Name and address of offender. Signature of the seizing officer. Details of documents retained. Time and place of occurrence, etc.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 5. How can you get the case disposed of?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 5. How can you get the case disposed of?. 5. How can you get the case disposed of?

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): You have two options:
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): You have two options:. You have two options: a. BY COMPOUNDING By appearing and applying in writing before the compounding authority and depositing the notified amount. b. IN THE COURT You have the choice for disposal in the Court having jurisdiction.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 6. How will you get your impounded documents released?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 6. How will you get your impounded documents released?. 6. How will you get your impounded documents released? From the court, if the case is to be disposed of in the court. From Compounding Authority / I. O., when the case is compounded.

title: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 7. How will you get your impounded vehicle released?
text: West Bengal Transport FAQ (Offences & Penalties): 7. How will you get your impounded vehicle released?. 7. How will you get your impounded vehicle released? After payment of the fines you will be given a vehicle release order and you will have to approach the custodian with that and pay the custodial fees, wherever necessary, to secure release of the seized vehicle.
